description: As of August 7, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:

	Prior to 11.1.0.2

Dell OpenManage Server Administrator Managed Node for RHEL 8.10
	Prior to 11.1.0.2

Dell OpenManage Server Administrator Managed Node for RHEL 9.4
	Prior to 11.1.0.2

Dell OpenManage Server Administrator Managed Node for SLES 15
	Prior to 11.1.0.2

OpenManage Server Administrator Managed Node (Patch) for Windows
	Prior to 11.1.0.2

Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Client

solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
